text: Bitcoin is essentially flat while Ethereum shows modest outperformance, suggesting selective strength in utility-focused assets rather than broad-based conviction. Fear remains entrenched at 29 with no directional shift over the week, and the $46B daily volume is subdued relative to volatility risk, pointing to low participation. Bitcoin's dominant 56.2% share indicates market structure hasn't fragmented, but the absence of rallying conviction across both majors signals cautious or wait-and-see positioning.
